name: Pip
subtitle: Pip, the money tracker with a coin mascot
description: Add this source to install Pip and get its updates.

apps.name: Pip
apps.subtitle: Track spending with Pip
apps.localizedDescription: Log what you spend in seconds, keep a daily streak, and see where your money goes. Pip cheers you on.
apps.versionDescription: A streak that forgives, and a look ahead. Rest days: every 7 logged days bank one, so a missed day no longer ends your streak, and you can still add yesterday to mend it. Pip now answers every log with what's left for today, a recap of last week shows up on Home, the logged-days grid turns lime on days you stayed on budget, and there are badges for 60, 100 and 365 days. The daily reminder has Nothing spent and Log something buttons. New under the money card: Afford it? shows what a purchase does to your daily amount, Didn't buy puts the price of something you skipped into a goal, and Trip sets a holiday budget aside. Also: a look back each payday, a did-you-use-it check on subscriptions, a forecast that knows your weekdays, a calendar for older entries, a tap on any Insights category to see its entries, and new animations on Home and the lock screen.
